glossary.tss: Training Stress Score — overall load from intensity × duration. 100 = 1 hr at FTP.
glossary.if: Intensity Factor — NP ÷ FTP. 1.0 means riding at FTP intensity.
glossary.work: Work — total work done this session (kJ). Roughly equals kcal burned.
glossary.kjPerHour: Work per hour (kJ/h) — a measure of average power output intensity.
glossary.trimp: Training Impulse — training load based on heart rate and duration.
glossary.recovery: Recovery time — an estimate of suggested recovery, scaling this session's load against your fitness (higher = harder).
glossary.np: Normalized Power — adjusts for variability to reflect 'felt' average power.
glossary.xpower: xPower (Skiba) — a variability-adjusted power similar to NP (25 s weighted).
glossary.vi: Variability Index — NP ÷ average power. Closer to 1 means steadier pacing.
glossary.cp: Critical Power — the max power sustainable over a long effort (≈FTP).
glossary.wprime: W′ (W-prime) — anaerobic energy capacity available above Critical Power.
glossary.matches: Match — a hard effort well above FTP. Burned like a matchstick, limited in supply.
glossary.ef: Efficiency Factor — NP ÷ average HR. Higher means better aerobic efficiency.
glossary.decoupling: Decoupling — drop in power:HR efficiency in the later half. Lower means better endurance.
glossary.sweetSpot: Sweet Spot — 83–94% FTP. Efficient fitness-building zone for the fatigue cost.
glossary.threshold: Threshold — time spent at 95–106% FTP on this screen. This is a power band, not a lactate threshold measured by a blood test.
glossary.vo2max: VO2max — 106–120% FTP. High intensity that stresses cardiovascular capacity.
glossary.anaerobic: Anaerobic — above 120% FTP. Short, all-out efforts.
glossary.fatmax: FATMAX — the intensity at which fat oxidation rate peaks.
glossary.metabolism: Energy metabolism — estimated fat vs carb burn. Population averages based on RER.
glossary.zones: Intensity zones — distribution of power/HR across intensity bands, each a distinct stimulus.
glossary.duration: Duration — total elapsed time from start to finish (including stops).
glossary.avgPower: Average Power — mean output across the whole ride (zeros included).
glossary.maxPower: Max Power — peak 3-second smoothed output; single spikes removed.
glossary.matchesTime: Match Time — total time spent in hard efforts well above FTP.
glossary.longestMatch: Longest Match — the longest single hard effort above FTP.
glossary.avgHr: Average HR — mean heart rate across the ride (bpm).
glossary.maxHr: Max HR — highest recorded heart rate (bpm).
glossary.hrDrift: HR Drift — rise in HR in the later half vs the first. A fatigue/dehydration/heat signal.
glossary.elevGain: Elevation Gain — sum of all uphill climbing.
glossary.avgSpeed: Average Speed — mean speed across the ride.
glossary.avgRpm: Average Cadence — mean pedal revolutions per minute (rpm).
glossary.maxRpm: Max Cadence — peak pedal revolutions per minute (rpm).
glossary.sufferScore: Cumulative HR-based intensity score. Higher = harder/longer session.
glossary.quadrant: Pedaling quadrants — time share across cadence×torque. High Q4 (low rpm·high torque) = strength-style; high Q1 (high rpm·high power) = high-intensity spinning.
glossary.longestZ4: Longest continuous time ≥91% FTP — threshold endurance.
glossary.cadenceConsistency: Cadence standard deviation. Lower = steadier pedaling.
glossary.coasting: Share of moving time with zero cadence. Stops are excluded. Average cadence counts only pedaling time.
glossary.pedalBalance: Left/right power share recorded by a dual-sided power meter. Values closer to 50/50 indicate more even output.
glossary.torqueEffectiveness: Torque effectiveness is the share of total pedal force that contributes to forward crank torque.
glossary.pedalSmoothness: Pedal smoothness describes how evenly power is delivered through each crank revolution.
glossary.platformCenterOffset: Platform center offset (PCO) is the signed lateral distance of applied force from pedal center.
glossary.powerPhase: Power phase is the angular range of a crank revolution where effective power is produced.
glossary.dynamicsCoverage: The share of sensor samples containing valid cycling dynamics data.
glossary.paceConsistency: Pace standard deviation. Lower = more even pace.
glossary.wPrimeBal: Time trajectory of W' (anaerobic capacity) balance. Depletes above CP, recharges below (Skiba 2015). A minimum near 0% means nearly maxed out.
glossary.fastestKm: Pace of the quickest single kilometre in this activity.
